field_changes.before: Passed by the Assembly 2026-10-29 (76-0-1), after committee report and second reading 2026-10-22; March 16 committee report with amendments referred it to Appropriations. Official Assembly history identifies S4400 as identical; separate Senate proceedings not reviewed.
field_changes.after: A3966 passed the Assembly 76-0-1 on 2026-10-29 after an October 22 committee report/second reading; its March 16 committee amendments produced the first reprint. The official description lists S4400 as identical; separate S4400 history shows October 8 second reading and referral to Senate Budget and Appropriations. API histories observed 2026-11-09; no enactment established.

field_changes.before: Directs DEP to study short- and long-term effects of large-scale data center water use.
field_changes.after: First reprint proposes a DEP evaluation within one year after an enacted effective date of large-scale data-center water use, covering drinking-water systems, wastewater systems and the environment. DEP, consulting BPU, would establish coverage thresholds using water use, electric demand, size, cooling/computing capacity or other resource factors; the print sets no fixed MW cutoff. The study covers preceding three- and seven-year effects, permits specified data requests and estimates, and requires a report within 15 months after an enacted effective date. These are proposed duties.

field_changes.before: Introduced 2026-03-19, referred to Assembly Telecommunications and Utilities Committee; no further action through 2026-07-31
field_changes.after: A4769 remains at its 2026-03-19 Assembly Telecommunications and Utilities referral. Separate S3639 remains at its 2026-02-24 Senate Economic Growth referral. Official histories observed 2026-11-09 show no later actions; no passage or enactment established.

field_changes.before: Requires certain State agencies to establish expedited approval and permitting procedures for artificial intelligence data centers powered by small modular nuclear reactors; a siting/permitting-track bill (companion S3639).
field_changes.after: Would require BPU, DCA and DEP to establish expedited approval and permitting procedures for AI data centers powered by on-site small modular nuclear reactors, with rules due within 12 months after an enacted effective date. Compared introduced A4769 and S3639 operative and statement text matches after whitespace normalization; their official description APIs do not list an identical-bill relationship. The text match is not a formal companion designation.
